report.explanation: Current read-only telemetry shows order checkout healthy: one OK trace at 65ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 77ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. No evidence supports any public cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). The alert's degraded claim is contradicted by healthy observations, so no bounded candidate can be established; hand off for operator review.
missing_evidence: Alert source and threshold that triggered the degraded checkout health claim
Telemetry from the actual degraded window rather than the healthy 03:18-03:23 sample
Per-dependency latency/error breakdown for inventory, payment, and postgresql
Redis and postgresql health metrics to rule out dependency faults
